Look at what each question type needs before tuning numbers: one sentence, the right document, or a whole procedure.
Procedures span three sentences, so the procedural chunk size must hold all of them.
Policy questions compete with keyword-stuffed noise: rerank lets you keep k at 1. The same rerank hurts FAQ lookups.
FAQ answers are one line: tiny chunks and k of 1 or 2 keep them almost free.
